picks.editorial_note: An OpenAI system reportedly produced an analytic proof and Lean formalization addressing part of the Navier-Stokes Millennium Prize Problem using ~10,000 autonomous AI agents — a landmark test of AI's capacity for frontier mathematical reasoning, not just applied science.
picks.title: Solução de problema matemático: como a IA está impactando a ciência? - Jornal da Unicamp

picks.editorial_note: CERN's strategic partnership with Mistral to build a foundation model trained on billions of simulated particle collisions signals a major convergence of frontier AI labs and big science, with implications for how large physics collaborations will use AI going forward.
picks.title: CERN and Mistral join forces to accelerate AI for science – Home

picks.editorial_note: DOE's Genesis Mission, discussed by undersecretary Darío Gil at the National Academy of Engineering, aims to link national supercomputers, datasets, and experimental facilities into a unified AI-for-discovery infrastructure — a potentially field-defining federal initiative.
picks.title: NAE Annual Meeting Spotlights DOE’s New Genesis Project and Other AI Initiatives Aimed at Advancing Discovery

picks.editorial_note: A White House-announced, 14+ university Southeast Regional Superintelligence Computing Consortium marks a significant regional push to pool advanced computing infrastructure, with Vanderbilt as a founding member — a notable model for academia-government compute partnerships.
picks.title: Vanderbilt among founding members of Southeast Regional SI Computing Consortium

picks.editorial_note: A $28.6 million federally funded multi-institution project (NATIVE-ID), with Brown playing a key role, applies machine learning to protein misfolding in neurodegenerative disease — a substantial investment at the intersection of AI and biomedical research.
picks.title: Brown scholar to play key role in federally funded project to prevent neurodegenerative disease

picks.editorial_note: UIUC's ESMDynamic model predicts protein motion dramatically faster than traditional molecular dynamics simulations, a genuine methodological advance that could accelerate structural biology and drug discovery broadly.
picks.title: AI model offers a faster way to explore how proteins move, study finds

picks.editorial_note: Rico Sennrich's ACL Test of Time Award for inventing subword tokenization (BPE) recognizes a decade-old technique that quietly underpins virtually every modern GPT-style large language model — a reminder of how foundational academic research shapes today's AI.
picks.title: A Smart Computer

picks.editorial_note: UVM's Board of Trustees reported record research funding of $222.6 million, including the largest research contract in university history, underscoring the scale of institutional investment flowing into AI-adjacent research infrastructure.
picks.title: UVM Board of Trustees’ Fall Meeting Highlights Research…

picks.editorial_note: A $19.2 million, five-year Army Research Office award to a UCF-led team to study light propagation via optical sensing and computational imaging represents a major defense-research investment with direct AI/computational methods at its core.
picks.title: UCF-Led Team Receives $19.2 Million Army Research Office Award to Advance the Science of Light

picks.editorial_note: University of Arkansas's $3.4 million share of a $20 million NSF-led project to build AURORA, a robot-controlled AI cloud laboratory for quantum materials discovery, exemplifies the growing fusion of autonomous robotics and AI in physical science.
picks.title: Robots and AI Could Speed Search for Quantum Materials
